程序包 org.bukkit.event.world

package org.bukkit.event.world
Events triggered by various world states or changes. 由各种世界状态或变更触发的事件。
  • 相关程序包
    程序包
    说明
    org.bukkit.event
    Classes dedicated to handling triggered code executions.
  • 类
    说明
    ChunkEvent
    Represents a Chunk related event 表示与区块（Chunk）有关的事件
    ChunkLoadEvent
    Called when a chunk is loaded 当区块被加载时调用
    ChunkPopulateEvent
    Thrown when a new chunk has finished being populated.
    ChunkUnloadEvent
    Called when a chunk is unloaded 当区块被卸载时调用
    PortalCreateEvent
    Called when a portal is created 当传送门被创建时调用
    PortalCreateEvent.CreateReason
    An enum to specify the various reasons for a portal's creation 用于指定传送门各种创建原因的枚举
    SpawnChangeEvent
    An event that is called when a world's spawn changes.
    StructureGrowEvent
    Event that is called when an organic structure attempts to grow (Sapling -> Tree), (Mushroom -> Huge Mushroom), naturally or using bonemeal.
    WorldEvent
    Represents events within a world 表示世界内发生的事件
    WorldInitEvent
    Called when a World is initializing 当一个世界正在初始化时调用
    WorldLoadEvent
    Called when a World is loaded 当一个世界被加载时调用
    WorldSaveEvent
    Called when a World is saved.
    WorldUnloadEvent
